 join (select t1."stkcode" AS "stkcode",  case   when t1."se001ntd00035727" between 0 and 40   and t1."stkname" not like '%ST%'   and t1."se001ntd00035711">0.5   and t1."se001ntd00035694">0.1   and t2."c1">0.2 and t2."c2">0.3   then '是' else '否' end as "白马股" from stock_astock_mkt_daily_trans as t1 join (   select distinct g4."stkcode" AS "stkcode",    power(first_value(g4."se001nqt00029003") over (partition by g4."stkcode" order by g4."i_date" desc)/cast(nullif(first_value(g4."se001nqt00029003") over (partition by g4."stkcode" order by g4."i_date" asc),0) as DOUBLE),1.0000/cast(nullif(nullif(count(g4."se001nqt00029003") over (partition by g4."stkcode") -1,0),0) as DOUBLE))-1 as "c1",    power(first_value(g4."se001nqt00029049") over (partition by g4."stkcode" order by g4."i_date" desc)/cast(nullif(first_value(g4."se001nqt00029049") over (partition by g4."stkcode" order by g4."i_date" asc),0) as DOUBLE),1.0000/cast(nullif(nullif(count(g4."se001nqt00029049") over (partition by g4."stkcode") -1,0),0) as DOUBLE))-1 as "c2",    first_value(g4."se001nqt00033033") over (partition by g4."stkcode" order by g4."i_date" desc) as "每股净资产"   from stock_astock_company_financial_data as g4    where  (g4."i_date" >= DATE '2021-08-31' and g4."i_date" <= DATE '2025-08-30'  and g4."i_date_exp"=0)   and g4."i_rpt" LIKE '%年报'   ) as t2 on t1."stkcode"=t2."stkcode" where (1=1 and t1."i_date_exp" = 0 )  ) as tblabel1 on g0."stkcode"=tblabel1."stkcode" where    contains(g0."se001snt00015648",'医药生物')    and tblabel1."白马股"='是') select  tb_wide.stkcode as "股票代码",  tb_wide.stkname as "股票简称",  tb_wide.se001nnw00035807_new as "最新价",  tb_wide.se001nnw00035814_new as "最新涨跌幅",  table0.* from  table0  left join stock_astock_latest_index as tb_wide  on tb_wide."stkcode" = table0."股票代码"

sheet1.取数SQL: with table1 as (   select g0."stkcode" AS "股票代码"      , g0."f2f##放量" AS "放量[20250929]"  , g0."f2f#macd#买入信号" AS "macd买入信号[20250929]"  , g0."se001ntd00009894" AS "主力资金流向[20250929]"  , g0.se001ntd00009894/cast(nullif(g0.se001ntd00009444,0) as DOUBLE) AS "主力增仓占比[20250929]"  , g0."se001ntd00009883" AS "主力控盘比例[20250929]"  , g0."se001nnd00026430" AS "个股热度[20250929]"  ,  case when tbbh_index2."stkcode" is not null then '是' else '否' end as "ma 多头排列[20250929]"   , g0."i_date" AS "交易日期"   from     stock_astock_mkt_daily_trans as g0 left join table(hq_index_ss('abs_股票领域', 'ma', '多头排列', 'i_date_exp=0')) as tbbh_index2("stkcode", "hq_date") on g0."stkcode" = tbbh_index2."stkcode" and g0."i_date" = tbbh_index2."hq_date"    where     ( tbbh_index2."stkcode" is not null  and g0."i_date_exp" = 0 )     and g0."f2f##放量"     and g0."f2f#macd#买入信号"     and g0."se001ntd00009894" > 0     and g0."se001ntd00009883">0.6       order by g0."se001nnd00026430" desc limit 500 ), table2 as (   select g0."stkcode" AS "股票代码"  , g0."se001snt00015631" AS "上市板块"   from     stock_astock_basic_info as g0    where     g0."se001snt00015631" <> '科创板' ) select    tb_wide.stkcode as "股票代码",  tb_wide.stkname as "股票简称",  tb_wide.se001nnw00035807_new as "最新价",  tb_wide.se001nnw00035814_new as "最新涨跌幅", table1.*,   table2.* from   table1   join table2 on table1."股票代码"  = table2."股票代码"  left join stock_astock_latest_index as tb_wide on tb_wide.stkcode = table1."股票代码"
